concern_summary: Lead Generation: Low and Irrelevant Leads
resolution_sop: 1. Verify the registered mobile number and firm name. Log in to the Seller Panel or IndiaMART Seller App. 2. Go to Leads > Buy Leads. Check current availability in your active categories and locations. 3. Go to Leads > Lead Manager. Review the last 30 days of leads. Mark irrelevant leads to train relevance. 4. Go to Catalog > Manage Services/Categories. Add all relevant subcategories under your service domain. Save changes. 5. Go to Profile > Service Locations. Confirm coverage matches your business scope (for example, all India). Save. 6. Go to My Account > Plan Details. Confirm the premium plan is active. 7. Go to Notifications/Alerts. Turn on SMS, email, and app lead alerts. 8. If Buy Leads show low or zero availability, go to Help > Raise a Ticket > Low/Irrelevant Leads. Attach examples and submit. 9. Request a priority callback from the premium desk or the account manager. Share preferred time slots. Note the case ID. 10. For more visibility and better relevance, offer a quick catalog and category audit and guide on keywords to improve lead quality.

1. Verify the registered mobile number and firm name. Log in to IndiaMART systems. 2. Open internal CRM. Retrieve the assigned account manager’s name, number, and email. 3. Trigger a priority callback from the account manager. Set the preferred callback window and mark urgency. 4. Share the manager’s contact details and the ticket ID via SMS and email to the registered contacts. 5. Offer alternate premium support options, such as the premium desk and in‑app support. Attempt a live transfer if available. 6. If no response within the agreed window, escalate to the premium support queue. Add notes on missed calls and business impact. 7. As a value add, offer to schedule a performance review call to optimize categories and improve lead flow.

concern_summary: Catalog Update: Add Products and Photos via App
resolution_sop: 1. Verify the seller and confirm access to the IndiaMART app. 2. Ask the seller to log in with the registered mobile number. 3. In the app, go to Manage Products. 4. Tap Add Product or select a product and tap Edit. 5. Enter the product name and a clear description. 6. Upload clear product photos from the gallery. 7. Review details and save the listing. 8. If they prefer, ask them to share photos on WhatsApp for assistance. 9. Share that once GST is available, a paid plan can boost visibility and includes design support.

concern_summary: Sales Callback: Paid Package Consultation Scheduling
resolution_sop: 1. Verify the seller and confirm the registered contact number. 2. Confirm GST status and readiness for paid plans. 3. Ask for a preferred callback time and date. 4. Create a callback request in the sales scheduling tool. 5. Add notes on GST timeline and current listing status. 6. Set the callback to the requested time and assign it to the sales team. 7. Confirm the scheduled time with the seller and provide the reference if available. 8. Remind that paid plans offer higher visibility and dedicated setup support.

concern_summary: Search Visibility: Company Profile Not Showing on Google
resolution_sop: 1. Verify the registered mobile number and email. 2. Log in to the Seller Panel with the correct account. 3. Go to Profile. 4. Open Company Profile. 5. Check the Display Name. Fix any spelling or spacing issues. Save changes. 6. Click View Public Profile and confirm the page opens. 7. Copy the public profile link and search your company name on Google to check visibility. 8. If not visible, go to Help and raise a ticket with the subject Google search visibility. Paste the public profile link in the ticket. 9. For better discovery, keep products active, add clear photos, and stay active daily for higher visibility.

1. Verify the registered mobile number and business name on the account. 2. Ask the user to log in to the IndiaMART Seller app. 3. From the home screen, tap the three-line menu. 4. Go to BuyLeads and open Latest BuyLeads. 5. Confirm the request is about buylead location, not company address display. 6. Open lead location preferences or filters. 7. Select the desired state only as the preferred location for leads. 8. Save the changes and confirm new leads reflect the selected state. 9. For higher visibility and more relevant leads in the chosen area, suggest upgrading to a paid package.

concern_summary: Lead Credit or Reversal Policy Clarification
resolution_sop: 1. Verify the registered phone number and seller identity. 2. Ask the seller to open their leads and go to Consumed Byleads. 3. Open the specific bylead. Confirm buyer name, city, date, and quantity. 4. Confirm what the buyer said and note the reason, for example, not their requirement. 5. Clearly state the policy: lead reversal is not available. 6. Record feedback on that bylead and submit it for review. 7. Advise selecting fresh byleads between 0 to 4 hours, with WhatsApp number, mobile number, and email, before consuming. 8. Value-add: Offer a short video meet to review lead selection and follow-up tips for better conversions.

1. Verify the registered phone number and seller identity. 2. Ask the seller to open the same bylead they consumed. 3. Cross-check the lead details on screen, including buyer city and requirement. 4. If the city or details shown differ from what the seller saw, request a screenshot for clarity. 5. Offer a video meet link so the seller can share their screen and show the exact bylead view. 6. Note if it is a direct inquiry or a posted bylead, and document the discrepancy. 7. Submit the discrepancy for review so the bylead can be checked. 8. Value-add: Advise reviewing all specifications and location before consuming fresh byleads, and follow up via WhatsApp for faster response.

1. Verify the seller’s identity and confirm active login. 2. Open the Seller Panel and go to Lead Manager or Byleads. 3. Open each affected lead from recent dates. 4. Use the Dislike or Report option on the lead. 5. Add clear notes: buyer not answering calls, WhatsApp off, and dates of attempts. 6. Submit the complaint to generate a ticket. 7. Share the specific lead details if asked by support for faster review. 8. Keep your phone reachable for the team’s callback on the ticket. 9. For added value, request a call from your Account Manager to review lead quality and optimization tips.

concern_summary: App Onboarding: Installation and Login Guidance
resolution_sop: 1. Verify the caller’s name and relation to the business. 2. Confirm the registered mobile number on the account. 3. Send the official IndiaMART application download link via SMS to that number. 4. Ask the seller to install the IndiaMART application using the same link. 5. Open the IndiaMART application. 6. Log in with the registered mobile number. 7. Confirm the app is open and the login is successful. 8. If there is background noise or poor network, pause guidance and schedule a callback at a specific time. 9. Resume with basic app usage training on the callback. 10. For better visibility and more leads, suggest exploring an upgraded plan after onboarding.

concern_summary: Lead Access: Unable to view buyer contact details from inquiry
resolution_sop: 1. Confirm the registered mobile number on the account. 2. Ask the seller to log in to the IndiaMART app with that number. 3. On Home, tap Messages. 4. Open the inquiry received via email and review it. 5. If contact details are hidden or a price-to-view is shown, explain that free accounts cannot contact buyers directly. 6. Offer options: complete the on-screen pay-to-view to open details, or upgrade to the paid plan for verified buyleads, direct contacts, and an account manager. 7. Once details are visible, use them to connect with the buyer. 8. For more verified opportunities, consider the paid service for higher lead access.

concern_summary: Payment assistance for lead unlock or paid service enrollment
resolution_sop: 1. Confirm the registered mobile number on the account. 2. Ask the seller to log in to the IndiaMART app with that number. 3. Go to Messages and open the inquiry that shows a price to view buyer details. 4. Tap the pay option and follow the on-screen steps to unlock the details. 5. If a payment issue appears, ask the seller to read the exact error shown on screen. 6. Offer to connect the seller to the paid service team for assisted resolution and plan guidance. 7. Share that upgrading provides verified buyleads and direct contact details for faster conversions.
